dwarf: A race of small people, sometime with long beards. This is a type of fictional character found in legends all over the world, whose main characteristic is being much shorter than normal.
In Scandinavian legends dwarves are considered as a true people, different from human beings.
A very little person. A dwarf is a person whose size is much smaller than average.
She is a dwarf, only three feet (one meter) tall.
If something is dwarf is it smaller than normal. Anything of a much smaller than average size can be called dwarf..
I kept a dwarf tree in my house.
If X dwarfs Y, X is much bigger than Y.
The elephant dwarfed the people with it.
dweeb: A dweeb is a person who is not cool.
What a dweeb -- he dresses like he is still in the 1980's.
dwell: If a person dwells somewhere, they live there.
I will dwell deep in the forest.
To dwell on/upon something means to keep thinking or talking about something, especially something bad or unpleasant.
He dwelled on the problem for some time.
To dwell on/upon something means to think or talk a lot about something.
dwelling: A dwelling is a building or place where someone lives.
The old house served as a dwelling for Albert.
dwindle: If something dwindles, it decreases in size or intensity.
